scope: The 882 explicit exact-byte source mappings in this package only.
checks: Every original source byte count and SHA-256 agrees with the accepted receipt or prior audit.
UTF-8 content scanned with the established collector_safety credential patterns and recursive JSON credential check.
JSON structures checked recursively for full native envelopes, hidden phases and sensitive role fields.
All capture text files verified against the accepted visible-fragment manifests and restricted to recognized visible user or assistant commentary/final text.
Metadata-only native references and ordinary project/account-directory paths retained; no native source file bodies copied.
Existing scripts preserved as historical evidence; none executed as part of the package build.
boundary: Pattern and structural checks are bounded safeguards, not a proof that all possible sensitive information is detectable. Original hidden/internal provider records were excluded by the preserved capture method; the exporter does not access them.
